audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits a 55.6% WR — Vex's passive taxes every Akali dash; her whole kit is dashes.
Spikes present and grounded: Lvl 3-5 dash-punish, Lvl 6 R-recast cancel of her E/R dashes, 1st item AoE through Shroud, late fear lockout. All four exist.

audit.why: Kit text: 'becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. The page's own spikes[2] already states the AoE interaction correctly.
audit.corrected: cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now say unselectable-but-AoE-hits; real numbers (W 20s, E 16s rank 1) written; pronouns fixed; bleed bullets replaced.
